name: docjacket
description: Connect your DocJacket transactions, tasks, deadlines, contacts, and contingencies to Claude Code, claude.ai and Cowork. Ten skills cover contract intake, inbox triage, document filing, morning briefings, closing prep, follow-ups and contacts. Every email is shown to you in full and goes out only after you say yes (or after a team member approves it in DocJacket, if your organization reviews emails); tasks, dates and contacts update right away. Sign in to DocJacket over OAuth when you install; no token to paste. Call `mcp_catalog` after install for the live tool inventory.
